brief.zh: 你和三台对手争抢九件补给。每回合重新扫描，用 choose_supply 决定目标。比赛结束时，你的补给数要超过任意一位对手。
brief.en: Race three rivals for nine supplies. Scan every turn and use choose_supply to pick a target. Finish with more supplies than any rival.

concept.zh: 复用带对手预判的目标选择，并随赛况重新规划
concept.en: Reuse a rival-aware target selector and replan as the race changes

hints.zh: 把 scan() 的 items 和 opponents 分别转换成 [x, y] 列表，传给 choose_supply。已经通过练习并保存的同名函数也能从 my_algorithms 导入。
hints.en: Convert the items and opponents from scan() into separate lists of [x, y] coordinates for choose_supply. A tested function saved under the same name can be imported from my_algorithms.

hints.zh: 脚下有目标就 pick()。否则只走一步，继续扫描。开阔场地里可以先对齐横坐标，再对齐纵坐标。
hints.en: Pick if you are standing on your target. Otherwise take one step and scan again. In this open arena, align the horizontal coordinate, then the vertical one.

hints.zh: 回放里看谁先拿走补给。同一个程序还要适应起点和补给位置不同的两张赛场。
hints.en: Watch who claims each supply in the replay. The same program also runs on two alternate layouts with different starts and supplies.

starterCode:
from algorithms import choose_supply

while True:
    state = scan()
    wait()

snippets.code:
player = state["player"]
    targets = []
    for item in state["items"]:
        targets.append([item["x"], item["y"]])

label.en: Read rivals and choose a target

snippets.code:
rivals = []
    for rival in state["opponents"]:
        rivals.append([rival["x"], rival["y"]])
    target = choose_supply(player, targets, rivals)

label.en: Replace waiting with a one-turn action
